newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo block trades total 98 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo block trades total 98 mln shares.

text.p: Around 98 million shares in Italian banking group San Paolo di Torino, equal to 12 percent of its share capital, were traded in blocks on the Milan stock market on Monday.
Slightly fewer than 90 million shares of the stock were traded at 10,842.6 lire per share, a further block of 8.2 million shares at 10,630 lire and 420,000 shares at 10,750 lire.
Analysts said the shares traded at 10,842 lire could be related to the building up of a core of stable shareholders in as part of San Paolo's recent privatisation operations.
"A price above the placement price would be justifiable in that case," one analyst said.
San Paolo ended a share offering on Friday and the final offer price was 10,435 lire per share for the public and 10,630 lire for institutional investors.
The group's ordinary shares ended up 0.78 percent at 10,785 lire on Monday.
